COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Self- Awareness in the Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Self- Awareness in the Community never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Awareness in the Community.
   D. Treat Self- Awareness in the Community as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Concept of Community Service Learning is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Concept of Community Service Learning.
   B. Treat Concept of Community Service Learning as rumours only.
   C. Say Concept of Community Service Learning never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Concept of Community Service Learning with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp.
   D. Treat Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Intercultural competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Intercultural competence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Intercultural competence as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural competence.
   D. Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Conflict Resolution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Conflict Resolution as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution.
   C. Say Conflict Resolution never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Conflict Resolution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr as rumours only.
   C. Explain Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr.

7. Which statement about Community Needs is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Community Needs never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Community Needs.
   C. Explain Community Needs with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Community Needs as rumours only.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

12. Which statement about Responsible Decision Making is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Responsible Decision Making with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Responsible Decision Making.
   C. Say Responsible Decision Making never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Responsible Decision Making as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

====

1. A — Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. D — Explain Concept of Community Service Learning with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A — Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. D — Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain Conflict Resolution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. C — Explain Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. C — Explain Community Needs with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. D — Nairobi

9. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. C — Plan income and spending wisely

11. C — Explain symbols used on a map

12. A — Explain Responsible Decision Making with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
